recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce SearchParameter.xpath for this historical XPath-specific issue; any future work should address current FHIRPath search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-6630 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Administration issue asking to replace the Patient deathdate search parameter XPath that matched any deceased[x] choice with f:Patient/f:deceasedDateTime.
initial_application: No FHIR-6630-keyed commit was found. Checked-in release history and the R4B source import show the requested XPath correction had been applied before current source refactors.
additional_context: FHIR-9772 later renamed the same parameter from deathdate to death-date. FHIR-32530 later dropped SearchParameter.xpath and renamed xpathUsage to processingMode, so the current source is expected to rely on path/expression instead of XPath. FHIR-23068 is a separate Patient-deceased token search issue that also notes XPath fixes were not being applied because XPath definitions were removed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/patient/bundle-Patient-search-params.xml defines Patient-death-date with path Patient.deceasedDateTime and expression Patient.deceased.ofType(dateTime), excluding deceasedBoolean.

related_jiras.note: Later style-guide issue renamed the same Patient deathdate search parameter to death-date, explaining the current identifier.
Global SearchParameter XPath removal explains why current source has no XPath field to edit.
Separate Patient-deceased token XPath issue references FHIR-6630 and records that XPath-specific fixes were superseded by XPath removal.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue reporting that Patient deathdate XPath matched deceasedBoolean and deceasedDateTime and should be f:Patient/f:deceasedDateTime.
evidence_items.learned: The final requested correction is to target only the deceasedDateTime choice element for the date search parameter.

evidence_items.summary: Patient is an active resource and Patient-death-date has path Patient.deceasedDateTime with expression Patient.deceased.ofType(dateTime).
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope source already encodes a date-only search parameter and does not include deceasedBoolean.

evidence_items.summary: Checked-in release history shows Patient-deathdate/death-date using XPath f:Patient/f:deceasedDateTime after the DSTU1 report.
evidence_items.learned: The original XPath correction was applied in historical published artifacts before current source refactors.

evidence_items.summary: R4B Patient source contained f:Patient/f:deceasedDateTime; the later XPath-removal commit deleted Patient search parameter XPath comments globally.
evidence_items.learned: The current lack of XPath is an intentional later refactor and not a missing FHIR-6630 fix.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue resolving to drop SearchParameter.xpath and rename xpathUsage to processingMode.
evidence_items.learned: Current source should not reintroduce XPath fields to satisfy old XPath-specific trackers.
